title: Minneapolis Building Permits
description: Live building permits from the City of Minneapolis: address, permit type, work type, valuation, fees, contractor/applicant, status and dates. Filter by issue date, type, value, neighborhood or keyword.
seoTitle: Minneapolis Building Permits Scraper (Live City Data)

issuedSince.title: Issued on or after (YYYY-MM-DD)
issuedSince.description: Only permits issued on or after this date.

workType.title: Work type contains
workType.description: e.g. Remodel, New, Addition, Repair, Demolition

keyword.title: Description keyword
keyword.description: Matches the permit's work description, e.g. roof, solar, kitchen

why: Minneapolis publishes every permit it issues, usually the same day. This actor reads that feed live, pages past the 2,000-row ArcGIS cap, and returns clean rows with ISO dates and coordinates.
useCases: Contractors and suppliers finding jobs as soon as a permit is pulled (roofing, HVAC, solar, kitchens)
Real-estate investors watching renovation and new-construction activity by neighborhood
Lenders, insurers and analysts tracking construction value over time
limits: City of Minneapolis only. Owner and applicant names appear exactly as the city publishes them.
Valuation is the applicant's declared value; trade permits often show 0.
